title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
title_zh: ArcRAG：知识图谱上的智能体式组合检索

paragraphs.en: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever’s configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过在由语料库构建的知识图谱上进行检索来回答问题。 然而现有检索策略都是围绕自身构建流程所产生的结构来设计的，而这些策略能否在构建方式改变后依然有效，却鲜有研究检验。 我们研究这种跨构建的可移植性：即一个不依赖任何构建特定模式、关系名称或重新调优的检索流程，在图谱以不同方式构建时能否保持有效。 我们提出 ArcRAG，它在推理时归纳出一个查询局部的图接口（即问题所提及实体可达的节点标签、关系描述符和属性键），据此规划多跳遍历，并以 Cypher 执行和修复这些遍历。 我们将 MuSiQue、HotpotQA 和 TriviaQA 语料库分别构建为模式引导图（带类型的节点、封闭的关系集合、来源可溯）和开放信息抽取图（无类型的节点、自由文本关系），并在两种图上保持检索器配置固定不变。 我们与一个构建无关的 Direct-Cypher 智能体进行比较，在两种图族上对各阶段在不同重试与通过预算下进行消融实验，并与已有 GraphRAG 系统报告的结果进行对比——其中大多数系统的检索设计都与各自的图谱构建捆绑在一起。 在两种构建方式上，我们发现检索无需与图谱协同设计：当构建方式改变时，查询时接口归纳可使构建无关的检索器保持有效，尽管构建方式仍会影响绝对准确率。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model in an external corpus by retrieving information pieces (passages) most similar to a query and conditioning generation on them. Similarity ranking is sufficient when the answer is contained in a single passage, and insufficient when the answer must be composed across several. Consider a question of the form which member of a given film’s cast has two children who attended a particular university : answering it requires enumerating a set, testing a property of each of its elements, and verifying a constraint that no individual passage asserts. Top- k k alone cannot perform these operations. Graph-based RAG addresses this by retrieving over a knowledge graph (KG) rather than a flat collection of passages, so that the relations connecting evidence are part of what retrieval returns. Composition, though, is only half of what these settings demand: in regulated domains — finance, law, healthcare, compliance — questions are seldom one-hop, and an answer must also be traceable to the specific disclosure, clause, or record it rests on. Success in these settings is evidence returned together with the path that connects it, rather than the k k passages nearest a query.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过检索与查询最相似的信息片段（段落），并以其为条件进行生成，从而将语言模型锚定在外部语料库上。 当答案包含在单个段落中时，相似度排序已经足够；而当答案必须跨多个段落组合而成时，它就不够了。 考虑这样一个问题：某部电影的演员阵容中，哪位成员有两个孩子曾就读于某所特定的大学——回答它需要枚举一个集合、检验其中每个元素的某个属性，并验证一个没有任何单个段落所断言的约束条件。 单靠 Top-k 检索无法执行这些操作。 基于图的 RAG 通过在知识图谱（KG）而非扁平的段落集合上进行检索来解决这一问题，使得连接证据的关系也成为检索返回内容的一部分。 然而，组合只是这些场景所需的一半：在受监管的领域——金融、法律、医疗保健、合规——问题很少是单跳的，答案还必须可追溯至其所依据的具体披露文件、条款或记录。 在这些场景中，成功意味着返回证据的同时返回连接该证据的路径，而不是距离查询最近的 k 个段落。

paragraphs.en: Dense embedding retrieval, the workhorse of naive RAG, cannot supply that, and the reason is structural rather than a matter of scale. Each passage is represented independently, while a multi-hop question depends on the relations among passages. As corpora grow and reasoning chains lengthen, the relevant facts remain individually retrievable yet become relationally invisible : a vector index surfaces the constituent pieces without representing the path that joins them, leaving the generator to reconstruct those connections from semantically similar text amid substantial surrounding noise. FinReflectKG–MultiHop demonstrates that this is not a deficiency stronger models will absorb: even reasoning-oriented models perform better given precisely KG-linked evidence than given text-only page windows that contain the same facts in less structured context ( Arun et al., 2025b ) . Knowledge graphs close this representational gap directly. Typed edges turn “which entity connects to which” into a traversable structure, and the traversal followed during retrieval can itself serve as provenance. This is the insight behind GraphRAG ( Edge et al., 2025 ) and the class of graph-based retrieval systems it inspired, and it reduces the open problem to a single question: given a knowledge graph, how should one retrieve over it?
paragraphs.zh: 稠密嵌入检索是朴素 RAG 的主力手段，但它无法提供这种能力，其原因在于结构层面，而非规模问题。 每个段落都是被独立表示的，而多跳问题却依赖于段落之间的关系。 随着语料库的增长和推理链的延长，相关事实虽然各自仍可被检索到，却在关系层面变得不可见：向量索引会呈现构成要素，却不表示连接它们的路径，只能让生成器在大量周围噪声中，从语义相似的文本里重建这些关联。 FinReflectKG–MultiHop 表明，这并非更强的模型所能弥补的缺陷：即使是面向推理的模型，在获得经由知识图谱精确链接的证据时，其表现也优于获得仅包含相同事实、但结构化程度更低的纯文本页面窗口时的表现（Arun et al., 2025b）。 知识图谱直接弥合了这一表示上的鸿沟。 带类型的边将「哪个实体连接到哪个实体」变成一种可遍历的结构，而检索过程中所遵循的遍历路径本身即可作为来源依据。 这正是 GraphRAG（Edge et al., 2025）以及受其启发的图检索系统这一类别的核心洞见，它将这一开放性问题归结为一个单一问题：给定一个知识图谱，应当如何在其上进行检索？

paragraphs.en: The difficulty in answering that question is that a knowledge graph is not one kind of object. Graphs differ in schema commitment , from open information extraction with free-text relation strings to schema-guided extraction against a closed, typed relation set, and in whether edges carry provenance back to a source chunk. Most GraphRAG systems fix one point in this space and design retrieval for it, and cross-construction portability is rarely tested directly.
paragraphs.zh: 回答这个问题的难点在于，知识图谱并不是单一的一种对象。 图谱在模式约束程度上各不相同：从使用自由文本关系字符串的开放信息抽取，到针对封闭、带类型的关系集合进行模式引导的抽取；同时在边是否携带可回溯至来源片段的出处信息方面也存在差异。 大多数 GraphRAG 系统在这一设计空间中固定某一点并针对它设计检索方法，而跨构建方式的可移植性很少被直接测试。

paragraphs.en: Instead, each fixes a point in that space and builds a strategy that presupposes it. Personalized PageRank presupposes a dense synonymy-linked entity graph, and returns a ranked passage list rather than a traversal a user can cite ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025a ) ; GraphRAG’s global search presupposes a hierarchical Leiden partition and the community summaries precomputed over it ( Edge et al., 2025 ) ; LightRAG’s dual-level retrieval presupposes an entity-and-relation keyword index and remains a one-hop lookup ( Guo et al., 2025 ) ; and PathRAG selects paths by a heuristic computed once over a precomputed path index, with no mechanism for noticing a wrong turn ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Agentic methods loosen the fixed strategy but not the coupling: LLM-guided traversal over graphs ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Jin et al., 2024 ) proceeds against node and edge semantics known in advance, and the BYOKG line ( Mavromatis et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2024a ) queries unfamiliar graphs but pairs exploration with a per-graph preparation or linking stage rather than deriving the semantics at query time (§ 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 相反，每一种方法都在该空间中固定一个点，并构建一个以此为前提的策略。 个性化 PageRank 预设了一个由同义词链接构成的稠密实体图，并且返回的是排好序的段落列表，而非用户可引用的遍历路径（Gutiérrez et al., 2025a）；GraphRAG 的全局搜索预设了一个层次化的 Leiden 划分以及在其上预先计算好的社区摘要（Edge et al., 2025）；LightRAG 的双层检索预设了一个实体与关系的关键词索引，并且仍然只是一次单跳查询（Guo et al., 2025）；而 PathRAG 通过在预先计算好的路径索引上一次性计算的启发式方法来选择路径，没有任何察觉走错方向的机制（Chen et al., 2025）。 智能体方法放松了固定策略，却没有放松这种耦合：基于大模型引导的图上遍历（Sun et al., 2024；Luo et al., 2024；Jiang et al., 2023；Jin et al., 2024）是在事先已知的节点与边语义之上进行的，而 BYOKG 这一路线（Mavromatis et al., 2025；Agarwal et al., 2024a）虽然可以查询不熟悉的图，却将探索与针对每个图的准备或链接阶段相配对，而不是在查询时推导语义（§2）。

sents.en: Instead, each fixes a point in that space and builds a strategy that presupposes it.
sents.zh: 相反，每一种方法都在该空间中固定一个点，并构建一个以此为前提的策略。

sents.en: Personalized PageRank presupposes a dense synonymy-linked entity graph, and returns a ranked passage list rather than a traversal a user can cite ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025a ) ; GraphRAG’s global search presupposes a hierarchical Leiden partition and the community summaries precomputed over it ( Edge et al., 2025 ) ; LightRAG’s dual-level retrieval presupposes an entity-and-relation keyword index and remains a one-hop lookup ( Guo et al., 2025 ) ; and PathRAG selects paths by a heuristic computed once over a precomputed path index, with no mechanism for noticing a wrong turn ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 个性化 PageRank 预设了一个由同义词链接构成的稠密实体图，并且返回的是排好序的段落列表，而非用户可引用的遍历路径（Gutiérrez et al., 2025a）；GraphRAG 的全局搜索预设了一个层次化的 Leiden 划分以及在其上预先计算好的社区摘要（Edge et al., 2025）；LightRAG 的双层检索预设了一个实体与关系的关键词索引，并且仍然只是一次单跳查询（Guo et al., 2025）；而 PathRAG 通过在预先计算好的路径索引上一次性计算的启发式方法来选择路径，没有任何察觉走错方向的机制（Chen et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Agentic methods loosen the fixed strategy but not the coupling: LLM-guided traversal over graphs ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Jin et al., 2024 ) proceeds against node and edge semantics known in advance, and the BYOKG line ( Mavromatis et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2024a ) queries unfamiliar graphs but pairs exploration with a per-graph preparation or linking stage rather than deriving the semantics at query time (§ 2 ).
sents.zh: 智能体方法放松了固定策略，却没有放松这种耦合：基于大模型引导的图上遍历（Sun et al., 2024；Luo et al., 2024；Jiang et al., 2023；Jin et al., 2024）是在事先已知的节点与边语义之上进行的，而 BYOKG 这一路线（Mavromatis et al., 2025；Agarwal et al., 2024a）虽然可以查询不熟悉的图，却将探索与针对每个图的准备或链接阶段相配对，而不是在查询时推导语义（§2）。

paragraphs.en: What these strategies share is not a common weakness but a common coupling: because each encodes assumptions about the graph it runs on, retrieval and construction cannot be varied independently. Agentic methods that let a language model walk a graph directly ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Jin et al., 2024 ) loosen the fixed-strategy assumption but not the coupling: they traverse using node and edge semantics supplied in advance, most often those of a curated graph with a fixed ontology (§ 2 ). The strategy we describe is specified independently of construction: one retrieval procedure, applied unchanged to graphs that differ in edge semantics and connectivity.

paragraphs.en: ArcRAG separates graph retrieval into exploration and exploitation. It reads each graph’s schema by introspection, which says how the graph is stored, and an Explorer queries the graph at inference time for a query-local graph interface : the relation descriptors and paths reachable from the entities the question names. Exploration is also prompted to surface aliases and paraphrased relation descriptors near those entities, so later stages work over the variants a noisy graph contains without an offline canonicalization pass. A Planner and a Generator then exploit what was found, choosing paths and executing them as Cypher, and the search returns to exploration when the evidence falls short. No step requires graph-specific prompts, relation names, or retuning (§ 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: ArcRAG 将图检索分为探索与利用两个阶段。 它通过内省读取每个图的模式，即说明图是如何存储的；在推理时，一个探索者（Explorer）智能体针对查询在图中检索，得到查询局部的图接口：即问题所提及实体可到达的关系描述符和路径。 探索阶段还会被提示去发现这些实体附近的别名和改写的关系描述符，使后续阶段能够直接处理噪声图中所包含的多种变体，而无需离线的规范化步骤。 随后，一个规划者（Planner）智能体和一个生成者（Generator）智能体利用所发现的内容，选择路径并将其执行为 Cypher 查询；当证据不足时，搜索会返回到探索阶段。 任何步骤都不需要针对特定图的提示词、关系名称或重新调优（§ 4）。

paragraphs.en: RQ1, mechanism. Does inducing a query-local graph interface and planning executable traversals against it improve compositional retrieval over direct Cypher generation, and how do exploration, planning, and retry and pass budgets account for the difference?

paragraphs.en: A formulation of cross-construction portability for graph retrieval: whether one retrieval procedure can operate when relation semantics, typing, and provenance are not fixed by its construction pipeline (§ 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图检索的跨构建可移植性的一种形式化：当关系语义、类型标注和来源信息不由其构建流程固定时，一个检索过程是否仍能运行（§ 4）。

paragraphs.en: ArcRAG , which induces a query-local graph interface from the target graph at inference time and plans, executes, and repairs compositional traversals against it (§ 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: ArcRAG，它在推理时从目标图诱导出查询局部的图接口，并针对该接口进行规划、执行和修复组合式遍历（§ 4）。

paragraphs.en: A controlled evaluation: a comparison with a Direct-Cypher agent, component ablations across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and a paired transfer design over schema-guided and open-vocabulary constructions of the same three corpora (§ 5 , § 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一项受控评估：与 Direct-Cypher 智能体的比较、在两类图族上针对重试与通过预算的组件消融实验，以及对同一三个语料库在模式引导与开放词汇两种构建方式上的配对迁移设计（§ 5、§ 6）。

paragraphs.en: Within the two LLM-extracted, entity-centric constructions we evaluate, the results support a bounded form of cross-construction portability: retrieval need not be co-designed with each construction when the retriever operates against an interface induced from the graph at query time.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们评估的两种由大语言模型抽取的、以实体为中心的结构中，结果支持一种有界的跨结构可移植性形式：当检索器在查询时针对从图导出的接口进行操作时，检索无需与每个结构共同设计。

paragraphs.en: GraphRAG ( Edge et al., 2025 ) precomputes community summaries over a hierarchical partition; HippoRAG ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025a ) runs personalized PageRank over an OpenIE graph, and HippoRAG 2 ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025b ) adds denser phrase and passage indexing; LightRAG ( Guo et al., 2025 ) maintains entity and relation keyword indices; and PathRAG ( Chen et al., 2025 ) prunes relational paths. A second group varies what is indexed: hyperedges for n n -ary facts ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , hierarchical aggregation ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , token-efficient construction ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) , separate similarity and relatedness indices ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , context-dependent structure ( Lau et al., 2026 ) , and path tracking ( Li et al., 2025 ) . In each case retrieval is designed together with the structure its own indexing step produces. The hierarchical lexical graph ( Ghassel et al., 2025 ) makes this coupling explicit: its retrievers address the statement, fact, topic, and chunk node types of its own graph model directly in their graph queries. Some works do vary construction: KGP ( Wang et al., 2023 ) compares several passage-similarity graphs, HippoRAG ablates its extractor, and Han et al. (2026) find GraphRAG performance stable across the LLMs used for construction. Studies that compare constructions directly hold a simple retriever fixed in order to judge the graphs ( da Cruz et al., 2025 ) , or recombine fixed retrieval operators with different graph types to find the best pairing ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . In each case the graph is the object of study and the retriever an instrument; whether a system transfers across constructions that differ in schema commitment, typing, and provenance is not tested. Surveys characterize when graph structure helps over flat retrieval ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) . Table 1 summarizes these differences.

paragraphs.en: IRCoT ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ) interleaves reasoning with passage retrieval, and KGP traverses its passage graph with a fine-tuned LLM. Over knowledge graphs, StructGPT ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) exposes reading interfaces for structured data; Think-on-Graph ( Sun et al., 2024 ) extends reasoning paths by querying candidate relations and entities step by step; RoG ( Luo et al., 2024 ) plans relation paths and grounds them in the graph; Graph-CoT ( Jin et al., 2024 ) interleaves reasoning with graph function calls; StepChain GraphRAG ( Ni et al., 2025 ) decomposes questions and searches a graph built on the fly from retrieved passages; and Graph-R1 ( Luo et al., 2026 ) trains an agentic retriever with reinforcement learning. Exploration is interleaved step by step with answering rather than summarized into an interface that a planner commits to. paragraphs.en: Closest to our setting is work that answers questions over graphs not seen during development. BYOKG ( Agarwal et al., 2024a ) explores an unseen graph once to generate query–program exemplars that ground later program synthesis; SymKGQA ( Agarwal et al., 2024b ) generates step-by-step symbolic programs from few-shot examples and grounds them with a retrieval-based resolver; and text-to-Cypher work ( Ozsoy et al., 2024 ) translates questions into graph queries given a schema. GRA ( Dragic et al., 2026 ) navigates a hybrid knowledge graph with generic tools and discovers everything domain-specific at run time, but is evaluated on a single graph. The most similar system, BYOKG-RAG ( Mavromatis et al., 2025 ) , generates entities, relation paths, and OpenCypher queries over custom graphs and refines them against retrieved context. It makes no construction assumptions, but its retrievers presuppose the conventions of curated KGs: relation semantics carried by edge types listed in a global schema, nodes addressed by name, and meaningful edge direction. Graphs whose relations are open-vocabulary strings stored as edge properties, as in our open-information-extraction constructions, violate these conventions : their schema exposes a single relationship type, so retrievers that select among types have nothing to select. This is the setting a query-local interface is designed for. These systems are also evaluated as KGQA over curated benchmark graphs (Freebase-based GrailQA and MetaQA for BYOKG; encyclopedic, temporal, and medical KGs for BYOKG-RAG), where answers are graph entities; none evaluates multiple constructions of the same corpus.They establish that LLMs can synthesize executable programs over graphs they were not built for, and ArcRAG builds on that; our Direct-Cypher agent (§ 5 ) represents this approach under our setup.

paragraphs.en: We apply FinReflectKG’s pipeline ( Arun et al., 2025a ) , in which an extraction agent proposes triples chunk by chunk and a reflection pass checks each proposal for faithfulness to its source chunk before committing it, to MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA. Two adaptations are inherently corpus-specific. In place of table-aware chunking we chunk at the passage level, following each corpus’s existing paragraph segmentation so that chunk boundaries align with the units the hybrid dense and BM25 retriever already indexes. In place of the business-defined disclosure schema — segments, risk factors, related parties — we extract against an LLM-constructed schema suited to encyclopedic text. The extraction-and-commit reflection loop is otherwise the same loop used for the financial 10-K graph. The resulting graphs have typed nodes and a closed relation set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 FinReflectKG 的流水线（Arun et al., 2025a）应用于 MuSiQue、HotpotQA 和 TriviaQA，在该流水线中，一个抽取智能体逐块提出三元组，并由一轮反思在提交之前检查每个提议是否忠实于其来源块。 其中两处适配本质上是与语料库相关的。 我们不再使用面向表格的分块，而是按照每个语料库现有的段落划分在段落层面进行分块，使块边界与混合式稠密检索和 BM25 检索器已索引的单元保持一致。 我们不再使用业务界定的披露模式——分部、风险因素、关联方——而是针对一个适合百科类文本的、由 LLM 构建的模式进行抽取。 除此之外，抽取与提交的反思循环与用于财务 10-K 图谱的循环相同。 所得到的图谱具有类型化节点和一个封闭的关系集合。

The harness reads each graph’s schema by introspection, with no hand-written schema or construction-specific names. The one other difference it observes, whether edges point to source chunks, selects the retrieval store and the evidence answers are composed from (§ 4.5 ).

paragraphs.en: Real-world knowledge graphs are incomplete and noisy ( Paulheim, 2017 ) : one entity is stored under several names, one relation as several predicate strings, and edges a question needs may be missing; open information extraction leaves entity and relation phrases uncanonicalized altogether ( Vashishth et al., 2018 ) . A retriever written against one construction’s schema inherits its assumptions about all three. ArcRAG’s stages can instead be read through the exploration exploitation trade-off familiar from search ( Kocsis and Szepesvári, 2006 ) , although no stage implements a bandit or tree-search policy. The Explorer explores: it establishes what the graph contains around the entities a question names, including their variants, without committing to an answer. The Planner and Generator exploit: they commit to the most promising explored paths and execute them as queries. When the evidence does not support an answer, the search returns to exploration. The budgets reflect the same trade-off: retries extend exploitation and passes renew exploration, and how much the Planner’s guidance adds depends on both the budget and the graph (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界的知识图谱是不完整且有噪声的（Paulheim, 2017）：一个实体以多个名称存储，一个关系以多个谓词字符串表示，问题所需的边可能缺失；而开放信息抽取则完全不将实体和关系短语进行规范化（Vashishth et al., 2018）。 针对某一种构建方式的模式编写的检索器，会继承该构建方式对这三者的全部假设。 ArcRAG 的各个阶段反而可以借助搜索中常见的探索—利用权衡（Kocsis and Szepesvári, 2006）来理解，尽管没有任何阶段实现了老虎机或树搜索策略。 Explorer 负责探索：它查明问题所指实体周围（包括其变体）图中包含的内容，而不承诺给出答案。 Planner 和 Generator 负责利用：它们选定最有前景的已探索路径并将其作为查询执行。 当证据不足以支持答案时，搜索会回到探索阶段。 预算反映了同样的权衡：重试延长利用，轮次更新探索，而 Planner 的指导能带来多少收益则取决于预算和图本身（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: Without exploration, a query generator guesses which entities and relations exist: S G S_{G} says how the graph is stored, not what lies near a question. Exploration supplies this, and canonicalizes at query time: explorers are prompted to surface candidate aliases and paraphrased relation descriptors near the anchors, so later stages reason over the observed variants instead of relying on an offline canonicalization pass. Phrases from the question are retrieved by reciprocal rank fusion ( Cormack et al., 2009 ) of dense and sparse search (line 4) to obtain anchors (line 5); chunks bound later queries to the subgraph they induce, while retrieved triples only hint where to look (lines 6–10). Two explorers each issue one batch of read-only Cypher queries (line 11), locating relations through S G S_{G} . Their report, S ^ q \hat{S}_{q} , scales with the exploration budget, not the graph, and is a per-question view, not an ontology. Exploration gives the largest gain in our ablations (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 若没有探索，查询生成器只能猜测哪些实体和关系存在：S G S_{G} 只说明图是如何存储的，而非问题附近有什么。 探索弥补了这一点，并在查询时进行规范化：探索者会被提示去发现锚点附近的候选别名和改写的关系描述，因此后续阶段基于观察到的变体进行推理，而不依赖于离线的规范化流程。 通过稠密检索与稀疏检索的倒数排名融合（Cormack 等，2009）检索问题中的短语（第 4 行）以获得锚点（第 5 行）；文本块将后续查询绑定到它们所诱导的子图，而检索到的三元组只提示去哪里查找（第 6–10 行）。 两个探索者各自发出一批只读的 Cypher 查询（第 11 行），通过 S G S_{G} 定位关系。 它们的报告 S ^ q \hat{S}_{q} 的规模随探索预算而非图的大小增长，并且是针对每个问题的视图，而非本体。 在我们的消融实验中，探索带来了最大的增益（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: The Planner is the exploitation heuristic: it decides which explored paths are worth executing, so the Generator need not find them by trial and error. From S G S_{G} , S ^ q \hat{S}_{q} , and ℐ q \mathcal{I}_{q} it fixes the answer type and emits a bounded set of subplans, each a traversal from anchors it attaches (line 12); a bridge question needs one, a comparison or aggregation several. One subplan is always an open neighborhood scan, so some evidence is gathered even if targeted subplans fail. The plan is fixed for its pass. Its value depends on the graph and the budget: on the typed graph it helps most when retries are scarce, while on the open-vocabulary graph it is neutral at small budgets and slightly ahead at large ones (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 规划器（Planner）是利用型启发式：它决定哪些已探索的路径值得执行，因此生成器（Generator）无需通过反复试错来找到这些路径。 基于S G S_{G}、S ^ q \hat{S}_{q}和ℐ q \mathcal{I}_{q}，它确定答案类型并输出一组有界的子计划，每个子计划都是一次从其所附着的锚点出发的遍历（第12行）；桥接问题需要一个子计划，比较或聚合问题则需要多个。 其中总有一个子计划是开放的邻域扫描，因此即使目标化的子计划失败，也能收集到一些证据。 该计划在其执行轮次中保持固定。 其价值取决于图和预算：在类型化图上，当重试次数稀少时它帮助最大；而在开放词表图上，它在小预算下表现中性，在大预算下略有领先（附录D）。

paragraphs.en: The Generator executes rather than proposes, so every result can be checked before it reaches the answer. It compiles each subplan into one read-only Cypher query over the descriptors and variants surfaced in S ^ q \hat{S}_{q} (line 14). One query chains the subplan’s hops: an open far end enumerates a set, the next hop steps across the rows returned, and a filter applies a constraint no single passage states. On chunk-backed graphs, queries are scoped to the retrieved chunks. The first attempt is the least constrained; an unacceptable result (Table 3 ) is refined by revising predicates and bindings while the traversal shape stays fixed (lines 15–17). This limits uncontrolled rewrites but does not guarantee that a correct earlier candidate survives. A subplan still unacceptable when its budget runs out is left to the outer loop; acceptable results join the witness (line 18).
paragraphs.zh: 生成器执行的是操作而非提议，因此每个结果在到达答案之前都可以被检查。 它将每个子计划编译为一条只读的 Cypher 查询，作用于 S ^ q \hat{S}_{q} 中呈现的描述符和变体（第 14 行）。 一条查询串联起子计划的多个跳步：开放的远端枚举一个集合，下一个跳步遍历返回的行，而过滤器施加单个段落无法陈述的约束。 在基于文本块的图上，查询的范围被限定在检索到的文本块内。 第一次尝试的约束最少；当结果不可接受时（表 3），会在保持遍历形状不变的前提下，通过修改谓词和绑定对其进行细化（第 15–17 行）。 这限制了不受控的重写，但并不能保证较早的正确候选结果得以保留。 当预算耗尽时仍不可接受的子计划被留给外层循环处理；可接受的结果则加入见证集合（第 18 行）。

paragraphs.en: The witness determines what the answer model reads (lines 20–21). The graph’s provenance, not a per-experiment choice, decides which applies. Each answer can be traced to the evidence it was given and the witness re-executed, though we do not verify claim-level attribution.

paragraphs.en: The loop is where the search returns to exploration. Within a pass, an unacceptable result triggers another attempt; across passes, an answer the evidence does not support yields a follow-up question q ′ q^{\prime} that seeds a fresh pass (lines 22–23), which can reach relations or paths the previous one missed. The witness accumulates across passes, and the loop stops when the answer is judged sufficient, no follow-up can be formed, or the cap is reached. More passes raise accuracy in every ablated configuration (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 循环是搜索回归探索的地方。 在单次遍历内，不可接受的结果会触发另一次尝试；跨遍历来看，一个证据不支持的答案会引出后续问题 q ′ q^{\prime}，该问题开启一次全新的遍历（第 22–23 行），从而可能到达上一次遍历遗漏的关系或路径。 见证在多次遍历间不断累积，当答案被判定为充分、无法形成后续问题或达到上限时，循环停止。 在每一个消融配置中，更多次遍历都能提升准确率（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on three QA benchmarks that differ in how much composition an answer requires. MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) chains up to four single-hop questions, with the bridging entities absent from the question text. HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) is predominantly two-hop. TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ) is predominantly single-hop and serves as a control for whether the harness degrades performance when little traversal is needed. For each dataset, both graph families are built and frozen before evaluation (Table 2 ), and questions are answered end to end, with no gold passages, entities, or hop counts supplied. Main results follow the validation-sample convention of HippoRAG and IRCoT ( Gutiérrez et al., 2025a ) . The component ablations use a stratified sample of 100 questions drawn from all three datasets and run on both graph families.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个问答基准上进行评估，这些基准在答案所需的组合程度上各不相同。 MuSiQue（Trivedi et al., 2022）将最多四个单跳问题串联起来，且桥接实体不出现在问题文本中。 HotpotQA（Yang et al., 2018）以两跳问题为主。 TriviaQA（Joshi et al., 2017）以单跳问题为主，并作为对照，用于检验在几乎不需要遍历时该框架是否会降低性能。 对于每个数据集，两类图族均在评估前构建并冻结（表2），问题以端到端方式回答，不提供任何黄金段落、实体或跳数。 主要结果遵循 HippoRAG 和 IRCoT（Gutiérrez et al., 2025a）的验证样本惯例。 组件消融实验使用从全部三个数据集中抽取的100个问题的分层样本，并在两类图族上运行。

paragraphs.en: We compare against two kinds of reference. The first is results reported for prior GraphRAG systems (Table 4 ), most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction (§ 2 ). The second is a Direct-Cypher agent: the Generator alone with a single attempt and a single pass, compiling Cypher from the question and the introspected schema with no exploration, planning, refinement, or follow-up pass. Given more retries and passes, the Generator alone becomes an ablation of ArcRAG, which we compare with Explorer + Generator and the full pipeline at each budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们与两类参照进行对比。 第一类是先前 GraphRAG 系统报告的结果（表 4），其中大多数系统将检索与其自身的图构建（§ 2）协同设计。 第二类是一个 Direct-Cypher 智能体：即仅由生成器单独执行单次尝试和单轮处理，直接从问题和内省模式编译 Cypher，不进行探索、规划、细化或后续处理。 在给定更多重试和处理轮次的情况下，仅由生成器单独执行便成为 ArcRAG 的一种消融变体，我们将其与探索器 + 生成器以及完整流水线在各预算水平下进行对比。

paragraphs.en: Studies that vary graph construction hold a simple retriever fixed to judge the graphs, and compare graphs from a single construction family ( da Cruz et al., 2025 ) . We ask the reverse question: whether one system, with its configuration fixed, stays effective when a schema-guided construction is replaced by an open-vocabulary one. We report what each stage contributes across retry and pass budgets (RQ1), how accuracy carries across the two constructions (RQ2), and where the results sit among reported figures.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究在改变图构建方式时，固定使用同一个简单检索器来评估各图，并且仅比较来自单一构建系列的图（da Cruz et al., 2025）。 我们提出一个相反的问题：当 schema 引导的构建被开放词表的构建所取代时，某个配置固定的系统能否保持有效。 我们报告每个阶段在不同重试与通过预算下的贡献（RQ1）、准确率在两种构建之间的迁移情况（RQ2），以及这些结果在已报道数据中的相对位置。

paragraphs.en: For RQ1, query-local exploration improves on direct Cypher generation at every budget we test: on the stratified ablation sample, adding the Explorer raises accuracy at all 18 retry and pass settings, by 15–39 points on FinReflectKG and 12–32 on the open-vocabulary graphs (Appendix D ). At five retries and five passes, ArcRAG’s best configurations reach 88.0% and 74.0%, against 50.0% and 59.0% for the Generator alone and 12.0% and 6.0% for the single-attempt Direct-Cypher agent. Planning is graph-dependent: it gives the best accuracy at budgets up to 9 on FinReflectKG, but not on the open-vocabulary graphs. Because exploration and planning add LLM calls, these comparisons control retries and passes, not total inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 对于RQ1，在所有测试预算下，查询级局部探索都优于直接Cypher生成：在分层消融样本上，加入Explorer后，在全部18组重试与通过次数设置下均提升了准确率，在FinReflectKG上提升15–39个百分点，在开放词汇图上提升12–32个百分点（附录D）。 在五次重试、五次通过的设置下，ArcRAG的最佳配置分别达到88.0%和74.0%，而仅用Generator分别为50.0%和59.0%，单次尝试的Direct-Cypher智能体仅为12.0%和6.0%。 规划依赖于图：在FinReflectKG上，预算不超过9时规划能带来最佳准确率，但在开放词汇图上并非如此。 由于探索和规划会增加LLM调用次数，这些比较控制的是重试和通过次数，而非总推理成本。

With the same configuration, ArcRAG obtains 38.0 EM on MuSiQue, 65.5 EM on HotpotQA, and 71.6 F1 on TriviaQA over them (Table 5 ). paragraphs.en: Table 4 lists, for each prior system, the best figure its authors report on each dataset, taken across all models and configurations they evaluated. paragraphs.en: This is an early study of cross-construction portability, and its scope reflects that. We evaluate two graph families over the same three corpora, chosen to differ in kind rather than degree: schema-guided extraction with typed nodes, a closed relation set, and chunk provenance, against open information extraction with untyped nodes, free-text relations, and no provenance. Two maximally different constructions test portability more severely than several similar ones would, but they do not establish transfer to curated ontologies or to graphs with different node granularities.
paragraphs.zh: 这是对跨构建可移植性的一项早期研究，其范围也反映了这一点。 我们在相同的三个语料库上评估两种图谱系列，选择它们是为了在类型而非程度上有所差异：一种是以模式为引导的抽取，使用带类型的节点、封闭的关系集合和分块来源信息；另一种是开放式信息抽取，使用无类型的节点、自由文本关系且没有来源信息。 两个差异最大的构建方式比多个相似方式更能严格检验可移植性，但它们并不能证明其可迁移至人工整理的本体或具有不同节点粒度的图谱。

paragraphs.en: Because the two families differ in both structure and provenance, the accuracy gap between them reflects both, and we do not separate the two. Canonicalization at query time is a design property of the harness; we do not measure how much noise or variation it absorbs. Comparisons with prior GraphRAG systems use their best reported figures, whose protocols and answer models differ from ours, rather than reruns under a shared setup. Each configuration is run once, and the answer model samples at temperature 1.0 and also judges whether its own evidence is sufficient, so the results carry run-to-run variance that we do not quantify.
paragraphs.zh: 由于这两个家族在结构和来源上都存在差异，它们之间的准确率差距同时反映了这两方面，我们没有将二者区分开来。 查询时的规范化是评测框架的一项设计属性；我们没有测量它吸收了多少噪声或变化。 与先前 GraphRAG 系统的比较采用的是其最佳报告数字，其协议和答案模型与我们的不同，而非在共享设置下重新运行。 每个配置仅运行一次，答案模型在温度 1.0 下采样并自行判断其证据是否充分，因此结果带有我们未量化的运行间方差。

paragraphs.en: The benchmarks are public and the answer model is a large pretrained model, so parametric knowledge may contribute to absolute scores; comparisons that share the answer model limit but do not remove this effect. Our experiments use encyclopedic QA and do not establish reliability for the regulated domains that motivate traceable retrieval: an executable witness does not guarantee factual correctness, and deployment there would require domain-specific validation and human oversight.
paragraphs.zh: 这些基准是公开的，且答案模型是一个大型预训练模型，因此参数化知识可能对绝对分数有所贡献；共享同一答案模型的比较能限制但不能完全消除这一影响。 我们的实验使用百科式问答，并未为促成可追溯检索的受监管领域建立可靠性：可执行的见证并不能保证事实正确性，在这些领域部署将需要领域特定的验证和人工监督。

paragraphs.en: All experiments use public benchmarks built from Wikipedia and web text: MuSiQue (CC BY 4.0), HotpotQA (CC BY-SA 4.0), and TriviaQA (CC BY 4.0). These corpora concern public figures and encyclopedic facts; we collect no new data from people and process no private information.

paragraphs.en: Per query, each endpoint runs an iterative retrieve–answer loop (Algorithm 1 ), capped at 6 passes:
paragraphs.zh: 针对每个查询，每个端点都会运行一个迭代的检索–回答循环（算法 1），最多进行 6 轮：

paragraphs.en: Introspect the graph’s schema (node labels, relationship types, and property keys) once per graph, and cache it.
paragraphs.zh: 对图的结构（节点标签、关系类型和属性键）进行一次内省并缓存，每个图只需执行一次。

paragraphs.en: Rewrite the query once, before entering the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 在进入循环之前，对查询进行一次改写。

paragraphs.en: Loop, each pass running the shared pipeline:
paragraphs.zh: 循环，每轮运行共享的流水线：

paragraphs.en: Exploration — extract search phrases → \rightarrow hybrid retrieve → \rightarrow deterministic gap analysis → \rightarrow 2 parallel graph explorers.
paragraphs.zh: 探索 — 提取搜索短语 → \rightarrow 混合检索 → \rightarrow 确定性缺口分析 → \rightarrow 2 个并行图探索智能体。

paragraphs.en: Planning — the RootPlanner decomposes the query into at most 4 ordered subplans; the PlannerAgent attaches each subplan’s binding anchors.
paragraphs.zh: 规划——RootPlanner 将查询分解为最多 4 个有序的子计划；PlannerAgent 为每个子计划附加绑定锚点。

paragraphs.en: Generation — the GeneratorAgent emits one read-only Cypher query per subplan.
paragraphs.zh: 生成 —— GeneratorAgent 为每个子计划生成一条只读的 Cypher 查询。

paragraphs.en: Execute every subplan’s final Cypher, render deduplicated chunk context, answer the original query, and self-judge sufficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 执行每个子计划的最终 Cypher 语句，渲染去重后的分块上下文，回答原始查询，并自我判断答案是否充分。

paragraphs.en: Stop once the answer is judged sufficient, or the proposed follow-up query is empty; otherwise re-run on the follow-up query, accumulating context across passes.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦判定答案足够充分，或提出的后续查询为空，即停止；否则对后续查询重新运行，并在各轮次之间累积上下文。

paragraphs.en: Terminology note. RootPlanner and PlannerAgent together implement the Planner stage ( Plan in Algorithm 1 ); GeneratorAgent implements the Generator ( Compile and Refine ); the two explorers implement Explore ; and the answerer implements Compose and Sufficient . A pass is one iteration of the outer loop; hops refer only to traversal depth within a subplan’s query. Node-creator and visualize/report/extractor calls (Table 10 ) are internal sub-steps of Generation, not separately named stages.
paragraphs.zh: 术语说明。 RootPlanner 与 PlannerAgent 共同实现了规划器阶段（算法 1 中的 Plan）；GeneratorAgent 实现了生成器（Compile 和 Refine）；两个探索者实现了 Explore；回答者实现了 Compose 和 Sufficient。 一轮指外层循环的一次迭代；跳数仅指子规划查询内部的遍历深度。 节点创建以及可视化/报告/抽取调用（表 10）是 Generation 的内部子步骤，并非单独命名的阶段。

paragraphs.en: Graph family scope. paragraphs.en: With one retry and one pass, the Generator alone is a Direct-Cypher agent: it compiles Cypher from the question and the introspected schema in a single attempt, with no exploration or plan, and answers 12.0% of questions on FinReflectKG and 6.0% on OpenIE. With more retries and passes it is no longer a plain text-to-Cypher baseline but ArcRAG’s Generator without exploration or planning: its refinement loop loosens or tightens a query in response to the result, and further passes restart retrieval from a follow-up question. This raises accuracy to 50.0% and 59.0% at 5 retries and 5 passes. That it does better on OpenIE at high budgets suggests that, with a single relationship type, almost any query pattern is valid, so refinement becomes a search over predicate strings; we have not tested this explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 在一次重试和一次执行（pass）下，仅生成器（Generator）本身就是一个 Direct-Cypher 智能体：它仅凭问题和内省得到的模式，在单次尝试中编译出 Cypher，不做探索也没有规划，在 FinReflectKG 上回答正确 12.0% 的问题，在 OpenIE 上为 6.0%。 当重试和执行次数增多时，它不再是一个单纯的 text-to-Cypher 基线，而是 ArcRAG 中去掉了探索和规划的生成器：其精炼循环会根据查询结果放宽或收紧查询，而额外的执行轮次则从一个后续问题重新开始检索。 在 5 次重试和 5 次执行下，这将准确率提升到 50.0% 和 59.0%。 它在高预算下于 OpenIE 上表现更好，这表明当只有单一关系类型时，几乎任何查询模式都是有效的，因此精炼变成了一种对谓词字符串的搜索；我们并未验证这一解释。

paragraphs.en: The Planner’s contribution depends on the graph. On FinReflectKG it improves on Explorer + Generator when the Generator has a single retry (by 3–11 points) and gives the best accuracy at every retry–pass budget up to 9; at 5 retries Explorer + Generator is ahead by 21–22 points, which suggests that committing to a plan narrows the search the Generator would otherwise perform. On OpenIE the pattern reverses: the Planner is no better than Explorer + Generator at budgets up to 9, and 11 points behind at one retry and one pass, while at larger budgets it is ahead by 3–5 points, within sampling noise at this sample size. One possible reason is that on an open-vocabulary graph a plan commits to specific predicate strings, and a single retry cannot repair a wrong commitment; we have not tested this explanation either.

sents.en: Since only part of the reasoning chain is resolved, answer synthesis marks the pass as insufficient.

paragraphs.en: In Pass 3 , the search narrows again by investigating the birthplaces of the candidate set. This eliminates several false leads and identifies the actual credited writers—Margaret Mayo, Z. Wall Covington, and Gardner Hunting—but their birthplaces remain unresolved.

paragraphs.en: This example demonstrates the iterative search strategy illustrated in Figure 3 . Rather than repeatedly attempting the same retrievals, each pass contributes partial progress by either discovering new entities, eliminating incorrect hypotheses, or adapting the search scope from precise entity-level retrieval to broader graph exploration. Evidence accumulates across passes and incrementally refines the active reasoning chain until the sixth pass has sufficient evidence to answer the question.
paragraphs.zh: 本示例演示了图 3 中所示的迭代搜索策略。 它不会反复尝试相同的检索，而是每一轮都通过以下方式贡献部分进展：发现新实体、排除错误假设，或将搜索范围从精确的实体级检索调整为更广泛的图探索。 证据在各轮之间不断累积，并逐步完善当前活跃的推理链，直到第六轮获得了足够的证据来回答该问题。

paragraphs.en: All language models and the embedder were accessed through an OpenAI-compatible inference API; no models were trained or fine-tuned, and no local GPUs were used. The pipeline is implemented in Python using the OpenAI client library for model calls, the Neo4j Python driver for Cypher queries over Memgraph via the Bolt protocol, and the Qdrant client for hybrid dense and BM25 retrieval ([versions]). The six main runs (three datasets, two graph families, 1,000 questions each) persist 85.78M tokens (Appendix C ), and the component ablations comprise 54 runs over the same 100-question sample. All settings are listed in Appendix B.2 ; agents run near-greedy (temperature 0.0–0.2), the answer model runs at temperature 1.0, and each configuration was run once.
paragraphs.zh: 所有语言模型和嵌入模型均通过兼容 OpenAI 的推理 API 访问；未训练或微调任何模型，也未使用本地 GPU。 该流程使用 Python 实现：通过 OpenAI 客户端库进行模型调用，通过 Neo4j Python 驱动经 Bolt 协议在 Memgraph 上执行 Cypher 查询，并使用 Qdrant 客户端进行稠密向量与 BM25 的混合检索（[版本]）。 六次主运行（三个数据集、两种图家族，每个 1,000 个问题）共消耗 85.78M token（附录 C），各组件消融实验则在同一 100 题样本上进行了 54 次运行。 所有设置列于附录 B.2；智能体以近贪心方式运行（温度 0.0–0.2），答案模型的温度为 1.0，且每种配置仅运行一次。
